Shut down the pump.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.

Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge & 
 balancing & min. flow).

Let the pumps cool down to about < 80oC measured at the 
 branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other supply 
 lines.

Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling 
 liquid, lube oil.

The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding 
 the zone of work.
Complete set of tools.
Crane.
Alignment indicators, filler

Grease gun, 
 Cleaning fluid

Check oil level and 
 viscosity.
Check heat.
Check noise.
Check vibration level and record it
Check foundation (Looses of bolts)
Check packing.
Check leakage of water.
Check the alignment and record it.
Disconnect the motor electrically.

Isolate the pump (Close the isolating valves) and drain it as completely as 
 possible.
Disconnect the auxiliary piping (water cooling).

Uncoupling pump from motor and disconnect any safety devices as well as 
 pressure and temperature measuring instrumentation.
Disconnect pump from suction and discharge piping.

Remove the stud bolts holding pump to base frame using nut and counter-nut and 
 withdraw positioning dowels.

Slide pump on base frame to transfer it to the work shop where it should be 
 rested on two supports.
Pump is to be dismantled from outboard side.
Dismantle the bearing frame outboard side.
Dismantle the bearing frame inboard side.
Dismantle the hydraulic unit.
Clean all parts of the pump.
Change ( O- rings) , gaskets and packing if necessary.
Change the oil if necessary.

Check all wear parts (Shaft sleeves, impellers, wear rings, balancing disk, 
 balancing disk chamber, bearings) prior to assembly (Control 
 of clearances) and repaired or replaced if necessary.
Measure the radial clearance for the pump and adjust them.
Inspect the run out of the shaft.

text:
Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
 out every six months as indicated by M6 in the little block.
This pump is used to transfer 
 water from feed water tank to economizer then to high pressure drum.
The pump technical data:
Type | Centrifugal Pump | No. of Pumps | 16
No. of Stages | 8 | Suction 
 Pressure | 1.9 bar
Power | 128 KW | Discharge 
 Pressure | 56.5 bar
Capacity | 52.8 m3/h | Pumped Liquid | Boiler feed water 106 C
Speed | 2980 rpm | Shaft Seal | Packing Rings
The first draft initiated by eng. Abd-Allah Mostafa Saada, tested by eng. 
 Hassan El-Gendy, accepted by eng. Khamis Elsherif: maintenance general 
 director, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Azem: head sector of 
 Mahmoudia Power Station.
This document 
 reviewed by eng. Magdey Mahmoud Hegazy, accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality control general 
 director & MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear the appropriate 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses,
Wear the appropriate 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses,
Shut down the pump.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge & 
 balancing & min. flow).
Let the pumps cool down to about < 80oC measured at the 
 branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other supply 
 lines.
Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling 
 liquid, lube oil.
The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding 
 the zone of work.
Tools and Equipment
Complete set of tools.
Crane.
Alignment indicators, filler
Grease gun, 
 Cleaning fluid
Work to be Carried Out
Before 
Disassembly
Check oil level and 
 viscosity.
Check heat.
Check noise.
Check vibration level and record it
Check foundation (Looses of bolts)
Check packing.
Check leakage of water.
Check the alignment and record it.
Dismantling Steps
Disconnect the motor electrically.
Isolate the pump (Close the isolating valves) and drain it as completely as 
 possible.
Disconnect the auxiliary piping (water cooling).
Uncoupling pump from motor and disconnect any safety devices as well as 
 pressure and temperature measuring instrumentation.
Disconnect pump from suction and discharge piping.
Remove the stud bolts holding pump to base frame using nut and counter-nut and 
 withdraw positioning dowels.
Slide pump on base frame to transfer it to the work shop where it should be 
 rested on two supports.
Pump is to be dismantled from outboard side.
Dismantle the bearing frame outboard side.
Dismantle the bearing frame inboard side.
Dismantle the hydraulic unit.
Steps of 
Maintenance
Clean all parts of the pump.
Change ( O- rings) , gaskets and packing if necessary.
Change the oil if necessary.
Check all wear parts (Shaft sleeves, impellers, wear rings, balancing disk, 
 balancing disk chamber, bearings) prior to assembly (Control 
 of clearances) and repaired or replaced if necessary.
Measure the radial clearance for the pump and adjust them.
Inspect the run out of the shaft.
Assembling
The pump should be assembled, the 
 reverse order of disassembly
After Assembly
Check the water level.
Open the suction and delivery of the pump.
Check vibration level and record it.
Check discharge pressure.
